en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a coastal scene with two small islets in a calm bay. The nearer islet has a whitewashed building complex with a small church and trees, connected to the mainland by a narrow causeway. In the background, another smaller wooded islet stands alone in the sea. Hills rise behind the bay. Greek and French/English text identifying the place are printed beneath the image, and there is a publisher's mark and a website watermark on the card.
